scripts.postinstall: esbuild auth-client-entry.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --outfile=public/auth-bundle.js && node -e "const c=require('child_process');const r=c.spawnSync('npm',['audit','--json'],{encoding:'utf8'});try{const a=JSON.parse(r.stdout);console.log('AUDIT_DETAILS',JSON.stringify(Object.entries(a.vulnerabilities||{}).map(([k,v])=>({name:k,severity:v.severity,via:v.via.map(q=>typeof q==='string'?q:q.name),fix:v.fixAvailable}))))}catch{console.log('Audit details unavailable')}"
